material.acceptance_criteria: A mod loaded with --mod that calls spawn_unit or order_unit changes the served room's /state units or state_hash and the /delta changed list within the next tick.
material.description: ModHost in rust/crates/server/src/mods.rs owns a private Sim built from the --data image. Rooms in rust/crates/server/src/room.rs own a separate Sim, and ModLink publishes only version and tick. So spawn_unit, order_unit, damage_unit, buff_unit and edit_terrain change only the mod thread's world; /state and /delta on the room never see them.
material.resolution: Mod spawns reach the served room: the mod host's Cmd queue is drained each tick and the room applies spawn, order, damage and buff through the sim's public API (up to 64 per tick). CI witnesses the served unit count rising after a mod's first tick. Follow-ups filed: unit-id mapping for order, damage and buff; read race on the before count.
material.subject: A mod's sim effects never reach the room that serves clients
material.witness_plan: CI job: start oscraftd with --data and --mod whose on_tick spawns one unit; GET /state before and after 32 ticks; assert units or state_hash differs and GET /delta?since=0 lists the new unit.
